title.description: The title of the TV series.

logoUrl.description: URL for the series logo image.

seasons.description: A JSON string containing all seasons and episode data.

forked_from.description: The ID of the original series this was forked from, if applicable.

database.instructions: This database stores user-generated TV series. The 'seasons' column is a JSON string which contains an array of season objects. Each season object has a 'seasonPlot' and an array of 'episodes'. Each episode object contains a 'title', 'plot', and 'imageUrl'.
